title: terms of working with me
caption:
terms of working with me. nobody reads these. you agreed anyway.

§1: messages after 6pm are read instantly, resented, and answered at 9:40am.
§2: no question is quick. §3: estimates triple when repeated to a client.

what would be in your terms and conditions?
